# External audio used in the internal demo

All listed downloads are marked CC0 on OpenGameArt.org. They are stored here for the team's demo build; original filenames are noted where useful.

| Local file | Source / author | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ambient_horror.ogg` | [Ambient horror](https://opengameart.org/content/ambient-horror), techiew | Quiet looping layer under the Level 0 fluorescent hum |
| `heavy_door_open.wav` (original: `door_open.wav`) | [Door Open SFX](https://opengameart.org/content/door-open-sfx), Oiboo | Exit seam opening |
| `mechanical_clank.wav` (original: `clank1.wav`) | [Mechanical Sounds](https://opengameart.org/content/mechanical-sounds), BMacZero | Layered onto valve turns |
| `horror_hit_bassy_01.wav` (original: `Bassy 1.wav`) | [Horror Hit Soundpack 1](https://opengameart.org/content/horror-hit-soundpack-1), psychhead_ | Layered onto the mascot jumpscare |

The horror hit pack includes its own `README.txt`; its instructions and the source page identify the pack as CC0. This is a curated subset, not the full pack.
